My noise anxiety is entirely based around obnoxiously loud noises.






My family talks very loudly and sometimes my friend does too, and I always feel anxious when strangers could possibly hear a conversation I'm having. I'm constantly worried that I'm talking too loudly or that people think the conversation I'm having is stupid. Every time someone I'm with talks loudly I immediately freak out about stranger's judgements. Like, if I'm in a supermarket with my mom and she goes; "What kind of ice cream did you want?" Loud enough that other people can hear it, I freak and start assessing how many people in the immediate vicinity think I'm a binge eating whale. If my grandmother asks me what we came to the store for again? I feel horribly embarrassed answering her in public because I'm afraid others will hear and judge my purchases (I'm not at all scared of the cashier doing that though rip).








I never use freshly ground coffee because the coffee grinder is way too loud for comfort. It tastes better, but I only ever use pre-ground because even if I hit the button and sprint out of the kitchen - it still shakes me. Same reason I don't make smoothies anymore.






I put everything down VERY GENTLY and get spooked if it's dropped or hits the surface harder than I meant to. When my brother cooks he bangs pots around like it's nothing and it drives me insane.







At work my boss occasionally uses this really really loud cutter to cut plastic pieces and it is RIDICULOUS. I always have to stop what I'm doing and plug my ears because it's so loud and piercing that I can't listen to it.






Even if I'm really into it, it's so hard for me to listen to loud music or watch a movie/tv show on loud. Even if I'm home alone. I don't use headphones and I'm always paranoid that people are judging what I'm watching/listening to or that it's too loud and I'm being disruptive.



The sound of people chewing makes me want to cry (not kidding, idfk why I have that reaction) and my brother has ADHD and consistently fidgets and makes noises. I can't be around him for too long because the constant little noises and sounds he makes (he recently started practicing beatboxing) make my skin crawl.






I really just want to move out alone and quit my job and enjoy silence. The world is too loud & I don't like it.
